title: ai relay-brief: no-slice code, template default and module home
findings_note: s322 relay 2026-10-17: relay-brief returns `unspecified` for an item with no slice; projects created before s322 list relay-brief.md as missing until `template reset`; ai.py calls the private `ops._missing_spec` and now imports ops, render, roles, store and templates
boundary: **Not in this slice:** the brief's content or placeholders.

sections.heading: Why
sections.body:
Owner questions from s322:
- `ai relay-brief` returns `unspecified` for an item with no slice, an exception to the docs/agents.md rule that the no-slice case is `no_slice`. Keep or switch?
- Projects created before s322 show `relay-brief.md` as missing (`customized: true`) until `template reset`. Treat a missing new default template as the default instead?
Code shape: `ai.py`, the onboarding module, now reaches into `ops._missing_spec` and four state modules. Moving `relay_brief` to a module that already reads state, or making `_missing_spec` public, keeps `ai.py` text-only.

sections.heading: Implement
sections.body:
1. Wait for the owner (flagged needs-owner).
2. Apply the answers; move `relay_brief` out of `ai.py` or make the helper public.

sections.heading: Check
sections.body: - `python3.12 tests/affected.py --run`, then the full suite. `slicer check` passes.

sections.heading: Git
sections.body: One commit on the slice branch; the owner lands it.
